name: Tam Tam Bunk Bed White
description: The Tam Tam bunk bed from Parisot has such clever storage options with the coloured shelves which makes this bunk bed a very practical buy for your child’s bedroom. As in the other Parisot ranges the core focus of maximises storage along with the functionality of the beds is clearly found in their best selling Tam Tam. The Tam Tam Bunk Beds have a fun and innovative twist with the shelving build in at the back, these coloured shelves brings a pop of colour to the bunks. The exterior frame has a contemporary feel with its clean and straight line and is available in a cool white finish or in the more natural “beech” effect.
